subject: Deletion request: purge of prompts, outputs, and inference logs for MedSync
messages:
From: Ava Bennett <ava.bennett@medsync.co>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: MedSync Security Team <security@medsync.co>
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: purge of prompts/outputs/logs for account MedSync

Hi Jasmine,

We need to initiate a full purge of user prompts, model outputs, and inference logs for our MedSync prod workspace (account: MEDSYNC-231). This is part of a compliance sweep tied to a client audit — we need deletion completed and evidence delivered to our security team by COB Aug 12.

Could you outline your exact workflow, estimated timeline, and the evidence you'll provide (manifest, timestamps, chain-of-custody)? Also confirm whether any traces persist in backups or analytics and how those are handled.

Thanks — appreciate a quick confirmation.

Best,
Ava Bennett
Head of Security Operations
MedSync

Attachment: request_summary.txt (text)

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Ava Bennett <ava.bennett@medsync.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2027 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Request: purge of prompts/outputs/logs for account MedSync

Hi Ava —

Thanks for the heads-up. We can run a targeted purge for MEDSYNC-231 covering:
- Prompt inputs and model outputs stored in prompt-output logs;
- Inference request/response logs (retention slices for the customer workspace);
- Any transient KV cache entries associated with the workspace.

Quick clarifying questions so we scope correctly:
1) Confirm all namespaces for purge: production workspace only, and not sandbox?
2) Do you need us to scrub aggregated analytics metrics (token-level aggregates) or only raw logs?

Planned workflow (high level):
- T+0 (confirm scope): we freeze writes to the workspace for a brief maintenance window;
- T+1 (scan): ops generates a deletion manifest of matching keys/objects;
- T+2 (delete): automated purge job removes objects, followed by KV sweep and cache invalidation;
- T+3 (verify): a separate verification job enumerates live keys;
- T+4 (evidence): we prepare a manifest CSV and chain-of-custody PDF, with signed timestamped hashes.

Estimated timeline: if we start tomorrow morning (Aug 10 09:00 PT) we can complete the sweep and delivery by EOD Aug 11 (slack window for any follow-ups). If you need COB Aug 12, we can shift earlier.

I'll loop in Marissa for verification and Ben for the manifest/artifact delivery.

-J

Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2027 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Request: purge of prompts/outputs/logs for account MedSync

Jasmine / Marissa —

We can execute the plan. Operational notes:
- Scope confirmed: production workspace only (MEDSYNC-231) — no sandbox artifacts touched.
- Backups: nightlies are immutable for 30 days; we will mark required backup retention records for targeted removal request and escalate to infra for eligible snapshot redaction where policy allows. If MedSync requires snapshot expungement, that becomes a separate request (we'll include instructions and expected lead time).
- Analytics: aggregated metrics are stored as derived artifacts; those will not be deleted by the purge job unless explicitly requested.

Attachments prepared: deletion_manifest_20270809.csv (manifest of object IDs to be removed), chain_of_custody_medSync_20270809.pdf (signed verification template). I will run the scan at 09:00 PT on Aug 10 and start the purge at 09:30 PT. Verification and final manifest delivery targeted for Aug 11 17:00 PT.

Post-ops verification will produce:
1) Manifest CSV listing removed object keys and token counts;
2) SHA256 hashes of manifest, timestamped and signed by the ops engineer;
3) A one-page chain-of-custody PDF describing the workflow and operators involved.

If MedSync needs DocuSign closure or an approved acceptance signature on the chain-of-custody, please confirm and we'll send a DocuSign link in the final email.

-Ben

Ben Carter
Production Operations Lead
Redwood Inference

Subject: Deletion schedule & confirmation: MEDSYNC-231 purge (prompts/outputs/logs)

Hi Ava / MedSync security —

Per our plan below, Redwood will perform the deletion for MEDSYNC-231 as follows:
- Maintenance window: Aug 10 09:00 PT — brief freeze to ensure no writes;
- Execution: Aug 10 09:30 PT — purge job removes prompt-output objects, inference logs, and clears KV cache pointers;
- Verification run: Aug 11 16:30 PT — enumeration to confirm no keys remain;
- Evidence delivery: Aug 11 17:00 PT — we will send the deletion_manifest_20270809.csv and chain_of_custody_medSync_20270809.pdf (attached).

Notes on backups/analytics:
- Nightly immutable snapshots are retained for 30 days by default. If you require snapshot redaction, we will open a separate backup-redaction request and provide estimated lead time (typically 3-5 business days).
- Aggregated analytics are derived and will remain unless explicitly requested; let us know if you want them purged.

Attachments included: deletion_manifest_20270809.csv (manifest of object ids scheduled for removal), chain_of_custody_medSync_20270809.pdf (signed template with operator hashes).

If this schedule looks good, please reply with an approval line (e.g., "MedSync approves purge for MEDSYNC-231 on Aug 10") and indicate whether you need DocuSign acceptance. Once we have your approval we will proceed and provide final signed artifacts.
